about_the_game: Ari's Journey OST features all the tracks from the game presented in a wonderful listening experience with 1 hour 40 minutes of music. In addition to all the orchestral music from the game, the OST includes retro 8-bit versions of all the tracks. This soundtrack is a masterpiece original work composed by Mat Campbell.
